Page County, Virginia Tax Sales: What You Need to Know

Page County, Virginia, holds tax sales to recover unpaid property taxes. These auctions offer buyers a chance to purchase properties while helping the county collect overdue revenue. If you’re interested in bidding, here’s everything you should know.

How Tax Sales Work in Page County

Page County schedules tax sales when enough properties have unpaid taxes. The county does not hold auctions on a fixed date but announces them as needed.

  • Auction Type: Public tax foreclosure auctions
  • Property Eligibility: Properties with delinquent taxes for an extended period
  • Where to Find Updates: The county’s website and auction platforms list upcoming sales

Tax Sale Details

Understanding the auction process helps you prepare and avoid costly mistakes.

  • Auction Location: Auctions take place at designated county locations or online
  • Auction Timing: Start times vary, but auctions typically begin around 10:00 a.m. ET
  • Registration: All bidders must register in advance and receive approval before bidding
  • Redemption Period: Property owners can reclaim their property by paying all back taxes, penalties, and fees before the auction. After the sale, they lose this right

Bidding and Payment Process

Winning bidders must follow specific rules for payment and property transfer.

  1. Bidding Process – The property goes to the highest bidder at auction.
  2. Deposit Requirement – Winning bidders must pay a deposit as outlined in the auction terms.
  3. Buyer’s Premium – Some auctions include an additional fee added to the final bid.
  4. Final Payment – The remaining balance must be paid within the timeframe listed in the auction terms.
  5. Payment Methods – Accepted payment methods depend on the auction, so review the terms carefully.

Where to Find Tax Sale Updates

Keeping track of upcoming tax sales helps you stay prepared.

  • Page County Treasurer’s Office Website – Visit PageCounty.Virginia.gov for official auction announcements.
  • Tax Sale Resources – Platforms like TaxSaleResources.com provide additional auction details.

Contact Information for Tax Sales

If you have questions about the process, reach out to:

  • Page County Treasurer’s Office
  • Address: 103 South Court Street, Luray, VA 22835
  • Phone: 540-743-3975
  • Email: pgray@pagecounty.virginia.gov

Smart Bidding Tips

To succeed in Page County tax sales, follow these best practices:

  • Lots closer to Skyline Drive tend to attract recreational buyers.
  • Confirm driveway access in rural areas—it’s not always guaranteed.
  • Ask about well and septic status if you’re looking outside the towns.
